trailhead.label: The Vuseum in Schluderns, the board’s start

cautions: Narrow wooden walkways with railings in the gorge: keep your dog close on a short lead.
Steep climb on path 18 to the Ganglegg.
Village lanes in Schluderns at both ends: lead on.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Narrow wooden walkways with railings in: Strette passerelle di legno con parapetti nella gola: tieni il cane vicino al guinzaglio corto.
Salita ripida sul sentiero 18 fino al Ganglegg.
